title: Staff ML Engineer
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role

We are looking for our first Staff Machine Learning Engineer to establish and lead our machine learning initiatives. This is a critical, foundational role where you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of data science and ML at Niche. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities, designing, building, and deploying machine learning models that directly drive business growth and enhance user experience across our platform.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on practitioner who is passionate about translating business challenges into data-driven solutions. You build, you code, you ship, you measure. You have a proven history of deploying ML models into production environments that have delivered tangible results. You possess the experience and desire to mentor future ML hires and establish best practices as our capabilities grow.


What You Will Do

  • Identify & Prioritize: Collaborate closely with product, engineering, data analytics, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize the most impactful ML opportunities that align with Niche’s strategic goals. Our first area of focus is our Recommendations, which includes matching students with the right schools
  • Design & Build: Lead the end-to-end development of machine learning models – from data collection and feature engineering to algorithm selection, training, tuning, and validation. This is a hands-on coding role
  • Deploy & Integrate: Develop production-grade code and systems to deploy, serve, and monitor ML models at scale, ensuring reliability and performance. Integrate models effectively into Niche’s products and internal systems
  • Measure & Iterate: Define key performance metrics, establish robust monitoring frameworks, analyze model performance in production, and drive continuous improvement through iteration and experimentation
  • Champion & Evangelize: Clearly communicate complex ML concepts, model behaviors, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences. Champion the use of machine learning & data science across the organization
  • Lead & Mentor: Establish ML development best practices, coding standards, and documentation. As the function grows you will guide and mentor other ML engineers
  • Innovate: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, data science, and MLOps, evaluating and potentially adopting new technologies and techniques relevant to Niche


First Year Plan

During the 1st Month:

  • Learn about Niche by meeting with various team members to learn more about our company through our Onboarding meetings
  • Deep-dive into Niche’s platform, data architecture, and recommendation systems
  • Align with product and engineering teams on business goals and ML impact areas
  • Begin shaping a roadmap for high-impact ML opportunities

Within 3 Months:

  • Deploy your first machine learning model into production with robustmonitoring and
  • feedback loops
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to define success metrics andintegration
  • strategies
  • Establish early ML development workflows, documentation, andperformance monitoring
  • Contribute production-ready code for feature engineering and modelexperimentation

Within 6 Months:

  • Drive measurable improvements through experimentation and model iteration
  • Introduce scalable MLOps practices to support deployment, retraining, and governance
  • Serve as a mentor and set engineering best practices for a growing ML function

Within 12 Months:

  • Lead ML efforts across multiple product areas, driving business impact at scale
  • Influence company-wide strategy through technical leadership and ML evangelism
  • Develop internal tooling, reusable frameworks, and scalable ML systems
  • Help grow the team through hiring, mentorship, and a culture of innovation


What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 8+ years of professional experience in software development or data science, with at least 5+ years specifically focused on building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Proven Impact: Demonstrable track record of successfully shipping multiple machine learning models that resulted in measurable business growth (e.g., increased user engagement, conversion rates, operational efficiency, revenue). You can clearly articulate the business problem, the ML solution, and the quantitative impact achieved
  • Technical Depth (Hands-On):
  • Expertise in Python and common ML libraries/frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, XGBoost)
  • Deep understanding of core ML concepts (e.g., classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems, NLP, time series analysis, experimentation, model evaluation)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and data processing tools (e.g., Pandas, Spark)
  • Experience with ML deployment patterns and MLOps principles (e.g., model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, feature stores)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) is essential
  • Business Acumen: Strong ability to understand business needs, translate them into well-defined ML problems, and connect technical work back to strategic objectives. You prioritize work based on potential business impact
  • Leadership Experience: Experience or a strong aptitude for leading technical projects, defining technical direction, and mentoring others. Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Education: MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, OR equivalent practical experience demonstrating deep expertise in machine learning


Bonus Points

  • Experience building ML capabilities from the ground up
  • Experience with recommendation systems, search ranking algorithms, or NLP applied to user-generated content
  • Experience in the EdTech or consumer-facing platform space
  • Familiarity with golang, express, Postgres, Snowflake, DBT, and Tableau
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or publications in relevant conferences/journals


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Python / FastAPI / AWS)
description:
About PhilSocial:


PhilSocial is a blockchain-powered Give-to-Earn platform transforming how social media influences the world. Valued at $1.2 B (2024) and empowering over 250,000 users worldwide , PhilSocial merges the best of social media with the best of humanity — creating the world’s first peer-to-peer social movement . We empower people to give, connect, and earn — bringing impact and generosity to the center of digital life.


About Position:

Position: Full-Stack Developer (React Native + Python / FastAPI / AWS)


Role Overview:


We’re looking for a mid- to senior-level Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in React Native and Python (FastAPI) , familiar with AWS cloud architectures , and passionate about writing elegant, clean, and scalable code.

You’ll join a cross-functional global team (Brazil, USA, Dubai, Spain, Ukraine, Colombia, and more) responsible for building new, complex features for the next phase of PhilSocial — while maintaining and improving current modules of our social media platform.

You’ll work remotely and collaborate daily with our Tech Lead in Brazil and Corporate Teams in the US and Dubai .


Responsibilities:


  • Develop new features and modules for the PhilSocial mobile app (React Native + Expo / CLI).
  • Maintain and refactor existing code with a focus on scalability, performance, and security.
  • Implement RESTful and asynchronous APIs using FastAPI , aligned with DDD and Hexagonal Architecture principles.
  • Collaborate with designers, blockchain engineers, and backend specialists to build seamless user experiences.
  • Contribute to system architecture discussions and participate in technical design reviews.
  • Write well-tested, documented, and maintainable code following Clean Code / SOLID practices.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and optimize API performance on AWS (Fargate, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront, etc.).
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews across time zones.


Requirements:


Frontend / Mobile (React Native):

  • React Native (Expo & CLI)
  • Zustand (state management)
  • MMKV (persistent storage)
  • React Query (data fetching & caching)
  • TypeScript


Backend (Python / FastAPI):

  • FastAPI, Pydantic, Async I/O
  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
  • SOLID principles
  • Hexagonal architecture
  • REST / GraphQL API design
  • AWS (Lambda, Fargate, EKS, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront)


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Web3 / Blockchain integrations
  • Familiarity with smart contracts or Solid protocol


Leadership Skills:

  • Ability to design scalable systems and make key technical decisions.
  • Experience leading 2–8 developers with accountability for delivery.
  • Clear communication, mentoring, and Agile mindset.


You’ll Succeed in This Role If You:

  • Are a go-to problem solver — you diagnose and fix complex issues independently.
  • Deliver high-quality, efficient, and clean code with excellent attention to detail.
  • Demonstrate technical leadership — mentoring others and influencing best practices.
  • Have strong time management — you’re reliable and proactive across global teams.
  • Communicate clearly in English (written & spoken intermediate+) ;
  • Thrive in a remote, multicultural environment , collaborating asynchronously when needed.


We offer:

  • Meaningful projects in social digital finance that impact real users.
  • Modern React stack, flexibility, and product ownership culture.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Full-time role in an international environment.


Compensation & Engagement:

  • Contract Type: Full-time Contractor (Remote)
  • Monthly Rate: based on experience and region
  • Work Schedule: Flexible / Global Team Coordination
  • Location: Anywhere (PhilSocial operates globally)

Send your CV / Portfolio / GitHub to with the subject line:

“Full-Stack Developer – PhilSocial”

title: Especialista de Patrimônio
description:
Sua missão como Especialista de Patrimônio será:


  • Atuar como autoridade técnica no controle da depreciação contábil e fiscal dos ativos fixos, garantindo o alinhamento com as normas contábeis (CPCs, IFRS) e políticas corporativas;


  • Realizar análises complexas sobre vida útil, valor residual, reavaliações, revisões de critérios e impactos financeiros de decisões de investimento em ativos;


  • Liderar o processo de teste de recuperabilidade (impairment) dos ativos, em conjunto com controladoria e planejamento financeiro;


  • Desenvolver e implementar melhorias e automatizações nos processos de controle de depreciação, conciliações e fechamento contábil de ativos;


  • Suportar e liderar projetos estratégicos relacionados à gestão patrimonial,reorganizações de ativos e mudanças em normas contábeis;


  • Atuar como ponto focal em auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo dados, explicações técnicas e coordenando a resolução de eventuais não conformidades;


  • Liderar os inventários físicos dos ativos fixos e propor os ajustes através das conciliações;


  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, pareceres contábeis e apresentações executivas com análises de impactos e recomendações;


  • Realizar análises do imobilizado/intangível em andamento;


  • Participar do desenvolvimento e revisão da política contábil de ativos e manuais internos de capitalização e controle patrimonial;


  • Oferecer suporte técnico a outras áreas da empresa (Fiscal, Suprimentos, Jurídico), assegurando o correto tratamento de ativos em todo o seu ciclo de vida;


  • Elaborar e manter KPI`s relacionados aos temas de Ativo Fixo.


Por isso esperamos que você possua:


  • Ensino Superior em Ciências Contábeis, com CRC ativo;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Domínio profundo das normas contábeis brasileiras e internacionais aplicáveis a ativos (CPC 27, CPC 01, CPC 46, IFRS 16, entre outras);
  • Forte conhecimento em depreciação contábil e fiscal, inclusive regimes especiais e impactos tributário;

title: Founding Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Equity Only / Part-Time) – Build a Global Mental Health Platform (US-Based)
description:
To our friends in Brazil: We are specifically recruiting here because the React/Next.js talent is world-class, but often underutilized in local markets. We offer a bridge: Keep your day job, contribute 5-10 hours/week, and earn substantial equity in a US-based C-Corp.


This isn't a job. It's a mission. One billion people are struggling with their mental health. 700,000 preventable deaths each year. Only a fraction ever reach the right provider because borders, languages, and broken marketplaces stand in the way.


Unacceptable. We're fixing it.


Really Global is building the world's first truly global, provider-centric mental health marketplace—so anyone, anywhere, can find the right human in their language, at a price they can afford. We're already live at really.global in 200+ countries. The foundation exists. Now we build the infrastructure that scales.


Next: an AI-powered booking and translation layer with real-time audio translation, making quality care as accessible as ordering dinner. This is a system-level play. When we succeed, access to care becomes normal. Suffering becomes optional.


The Opportunity: Put Your Name on the Blueprint.

This is pure sweat equity for a true builder who's ready to trade the safety of a salary for substantial ownership in a $100M+ platform. You won't be building from scratch—you'll be accelerating what's already moving. Typical commitment: 5-10 hours/week, equity-only, alongside your primary role.


You won't be "feature support." You'll be foundational—your fingerprints on architecture, UX, velocity, and every product decision that helps someone find hope in their darkest moment.


We're backed by founders with a track record of scaling ventures to $130M+ in revenue. This will be the hardest and most meaningful work of your life.


Who You Are (and how you show up)


  • Mission-obsessed. The mental health gap bothers you enough to build the fix.
  • Owner's mindset. You grab the problem, simplify, and ship. Weekly.
  • Resourceful as hell. You bias to MVP, learn in production, and improve fast.
  • Resilient. You want the hard thing because the hard thing matters.
  • Clear, candid communicator. Crisp async writing; short demos; low-ego reviews.
  • Efficiency and Output Driven: Comfortable leaning hard on tools like Cursor, Claude, or Copilot to move 2x faster, or excited to learn and get there fast.


What You'll Build (and why it matters)

End-to-end product slices that remove friction between someone in crisis and someone who can help. Check really.global to see where we are. Here's what's next:


  • Add recurring calendar availability
  • Publish existing SEO content at scale and optimize the site
  • Roll out the Hotline
  • Complete Talk Now (instant sessions) and Find Matches (survey → ranked suggestions)
  • Add location-based navigation
  • Add site-wide translation and real-time audio translation
  • API/MCP integrations


Our stack: Next.js/React on the front; Python services; Postgres underneath; GitHub, AI-assisted workflows (Cursor/Copilot) to move faster without lowering the bar.


The Deal: Transparent Equity Partnership


  • Merit-based ownership. Contribution translates directly to equity from a dedicated 5% contributor pool. Your stake grows with every outcome you ship.
  • Points-for-outcomes system. We measure contribution in Story Points, a standard unit of complexity, not hours. This rewards your efficiency and impact.
  • All work is valued. You earn points not just for new features, but also for essential “glue work” like bug fixes, documentation, and incident response.
  • Real shipped value. Ownership accrues only when your work is reviewed by a peer (reviewer ≠ author), merged, and live in production. To protect our quality bar, we have a "regression clawback" for code that causes critical bugs.
  • Clear commitment & vesting. We use a 6-month active contribution cliff with a minimum monthly point threshold to ensure we're a great fit. After the cliff, your grant vests over a 3-year period.
  • Quarterly tranches. We calculate and update your accrued share from the dedicated pool each quarter; any unallocated equity rolls forward to the next. This ensures early contributions are fairly rewarded without burning through the pool.
  • High-impact bounties. Mission-critical milestones (e.g., Talk Now launch) carry outsized point rewards to align effort with key business goals.
  • Locked-in stake. When we close our first priced funding round, the program freezes and everyone's earned percentage becomes a fixed part of our cap table.
  • No hours theater. No politics. Value in production = ownership. All details are codified in a formal, transparent agreement covering vesting, IP, and security.


Why This Will Define Your Career


  • Build Your US Track Record: This is your entry point into the US startup ecosystem. You aren't outsourcing; you are a partner.
  • USD-Denominated Upside: You are trading time now for ownership in a dollar-based asset ($100M+ target valuation).
  • Direct Access: You work directly with US founders. No middle management. No "local office" politics.
  • Human Impact: Your code will literally save lives in 200+ countries, including your own.


Are You the One? If you felt a fire light up reading this—if the scale excites you more than it scares you—we want to hear from you.


This isn't for everyone. But for the right person, this is the opportunity of a lifetime.


To Apply: Send:

  • GitHub (or 1-2 PRs you're proud of) If you can include links to the actual PRs or issues (and a sentence or two of context), even better.
  • A short note: why this mission, and one gnarly problem you've shipped through


If you talk in hours, skip. If you talk in shipped outcomes, welcome.

Position Summary

We are looking for a Customer Support & Revenue Operations Specialist to join a fast-growing real estate startup in the U.S. This is a hybrid role that combines helpdesk support, HubSpot operations, outbound sales assistance, and light marketing support.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing support tickets, excellent communication skills, deep familiarity with HubSpot, and the ability to multitask across customer support, RevOps, and sales processes in a fast-paced startup environment.


Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Helpdesk (40–50%)

  • Serve as the primary responder for inbound support tickets from users.
  • Monitor, triage, and resolve issues through HubSpot Service Hub.
  • Maintain strong response/resolution times with empathetic, professional communication.
  • Document common issues and build internal resources or playbooks.


HubSpot Operations & Administration (20–25%)

  • Manage and optimize workflows, pipelines, automations, and ticket management across HubSpot.
  • Maintain data accuracy for contacts, deals, and support tickets.
  • Support setup and QA of new sequences, processes, and automation in HubSpot.
  • Pull basic reports on sales activity, ticket volume, and marketing performance.


Outbound Sales & Appointment Setting (20–25%)

  • Execute outbound email campaigns and sequences targeting prospects such as real estate agents or brokers.
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads following defined playbooks.
  • Set calls and demos for the sales team.
  • Track all activities and updates inside HubSpot.


Marketing Support (5–10%)

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, list building, and segmentation.
  • Support basic digital marketing tasks as needed.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of customer support or helpdesk experience (B2B SaaS experience preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including:
  • Service/Operations Hub (tickets, workflows, automation)
  • Sales Hub (pipelines, deals, sequences, tasks)
  • Proven success managing support tickets as a core responsibility.
  • Experience supporting outbound sales workflows, sequences, and appointment setting.
  • Familiarity with email marketing or digital campaign support.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with shifting demands.
  • Availability to work 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM MST .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in real estate or PropTech industries.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Canva.
  • Experience building support documentation, macros, or knowledge base articles.
  • Track record of improving support metrics or boosting outbound meeting conversions.


What We Offer

  • Fully Remote Position! Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Professional Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and skill development.
  • Take Your Local Holidays: We respect your cultural and personal commitments.
  • Impact: Join a mission-driven U.S. startup where your work directly enhances customer experience and revenue operations.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.

  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.

  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Title: Regulatory Research Analyst

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, and you’re responsible for your own taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


Overview

We are seeking an experienced Regulatory Research Analyst to join the Tax & Regulations team of a global independent support provider. This fully remote role focuses on researching and tracking global trade regulations —primarily across LATAM and North America—and contributing insights that help keep SAP GTS systems up to date for global clients. The analyst will act as the first point of contact for new legal and regulatory changes and work closely with Business Analysts and ERP/GTS specialists. Client interaction is minimal; the role is primarily research-oriented.


Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Research & Analysis

  • Monitor and maintain up-to-date awareness of legislative and regulatory changes in assigned countries using government websites, agencies, third-party sources, and in-country experts.
  • Track global trade compliance regulations, including customs duties, export controls, sanctions, tariff updates , and other relevant requirements across jurisdictions (U.S., Canada, LATAM, etc.).
  • Interpret, analyze, and document new or amended legislation in an internal repository with high accuracy and clarity.
  • Prepare comparative analyses of regulatory changes when required.
  • Ensure research and documentation meet ISO process standards .

SAP GTS Alignment

Research and provide insights relevant to SAP GTS (v11 or similar), supporting product specialists on topics such as:

  • Export Control & Licensing
  • Import Control & Market Access
  • Sanctions & Restricted Party Compliance
  • Customs & Tariff Management
  • Trade Agreements & Origin Management
  • Regulatory Reporting & Declarations
  • Product & Classification Compliance

Collaboration & Documentation

  • Deliver clear summaries and detailed regulatory insights needed by ERP and product specialists to implement system changes for clients.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow researchers to validate findings and maintain consistency.
  • Support research expansion into Indirect Tax topics (VAT, GST, country-specific filing requirements) where applicable.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bilingual: English + one LATAM language (Spanish or Portuguese) .
  • 5+ years of professional experience in tax, global trade, or international regulatory research.
  • Working knowledge of SAP GTS or similar trade compliance systems.
  • Familiarity with international trade laws and frameworks (EAR, ITAR, EU Dual Use, WCO, etc.).
  • Strong research, analytical, and documentation skills with excellent attention to detail.


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and handle multiple tasks under pressure.
  • Strong internet-based research capabilities and proficiency in business applications (Microsoft Office, Google tools, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Experience compiling complex regulatory information into clear, actionable summaries.
  • Technical understanding of SAP ERP tax/accounting workflows (advantageous, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tools like Excel, PDF generation, ABBYY FineReader, Deepl, Inoreader, Beyond Compare (training provided).
  • Self-starter with strong initiative, resourcefulness, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Additional background in finance or tax is a plus.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely while contributing to high-impact global compliance research.
  • Collaborate with a diverse international team of trade and tax experts.
  • Play a key role in helping global clients stay compliant with rapidly evolving regulations.

As a Data Engineer you will design, build and maintain the core infrastructure that enables data processing, analytics, data science and data management across the business.


You will work in a multi account and multi region AWS environment that follows zero trust and least privilege principles. Infrastructure as Code and CI CD will be central to how you operate, alongside continuous improvement and strong governance.

  • Build and maintain cloud based infrastructure using Cloud Formation and SAM
  • Design and implement data processing environments using AWS services such as Glue, EMR, Sagemaker, Redshift, Aurora and Snowflake
  • Build data processing pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, Spark, Lambda, Step Functions and Apache Airflow
  • Monitor performance, cost and security of the data platform
  • Apply strong data governance and access control for sensitive data
  • Collaborate with multiple teams to support the wider data platform strategy


What You Need


  • Six years or more experience in a Data Engineering or Data Infrastructure role
  • Strong experience building data architectures in AWS
  • Solid coding skills in Python and SQL, Golang
  • Strong Cloud Formation knowledge
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Postgres or Redshift
  • Good coding discipline including documentation, unit testing and version control
  • Experience with Git and CI CD tools such as GitLab
  • Worked in Agile teams and ceremonies
  • Strong problem solving skills and excellent communication


Nice to Have

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

  • Contratação: CLT

  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em AWS , com vivência prática em serviços como EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

The FP&A Finance team is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support FP&A and month-end close activities across the Products FP&A team .   • Experience in multi-national, dynamic business environments
  • Technical Skills :
  • Advanced Excel modeling and automation
  • ERP systems (Oracle required), Hyperion reporting
  • Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint; Excel: intermediate to advanced)
  • Soft Skills :
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Detail-oriented with excellent time management and prioritization
  • Clear communicator with ability to present data simply and effectively
  • Team-oriented, self-starter, and comfortable working cross-functionally
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

description:

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas.   • Habilidades avançadas em SQL para manipulação e integração complexa de dados;

  • Experiência em Azure;

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

CLT.

A profundidade do nosso pensamento e a imersão no cliente são premissas do nosso trabalho. Primeiro, questionamos o problema, para depois buscar as possíveis soluções. Por isso, as possibilidades são múltiplas e permeiam todos os pontos de contato do público com a marca. A versatilidade do seu trabalho para elaborar diferentes materiais e sua habilidade em lidar com diversos segmentos contam muitos pontos para este papel.


✨ Nossas expectativas


Esperamos que todo(a) commcepter:

  • Traga novas ideias, some e vá além do “briefing”
  • Seja caprichoso, organizado e tenha atenção aos detalhes
  • Saiba ouvir e trabalhar colaborativamente
  • Concorde que design é mais do que layout e conceito não é “blá blá”
  • Goste de trabalhar com diferentes projetos, dos simples aos mais complexos
  • Busque aprender e se desenvolver com novas experiências e situações desafiadoras

  • Seja inovador na criação de campanhas e comunicação de marca

  • Tenha um bom conhecimento do pacote Adobe (InDesign, Illustrator e Photoshop)
  • Tenha um nível de inglês intermediário para lidar com projetos globais


Especialidades desejadas:

  • Ter uma boa redação para a criação de chamadas e conteúdos
  • Ter habilidades de composição de storyboards e de animações / motion graphics
  • E/ou se interessar por UX-UI Design, saber criar e prototipar interfaces


Key Words: Multidisciplinary Design / Graphic Design / Brand Design / Visual Design / Brand Communication / Digital Design / Content Design / Design Research / Motion Design


Híbrido - Curitiba (Remote First)


É importante você saber que nossa forma de trabalho principal é remota, por isso contamos que você esteja disposto a trabalhar em casa. Buscamos pessoas que moram em Curitiba e região para encontros presenciais em nossa sede, quando necessário.

If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team! Please review the minimum education/experience requirements below to see if you qualify for the position.


About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies.


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.


Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses:


Compensation:


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $4,200 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 1 year with competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL.

The total compensation amount includes benefits which are:

·      Gym membership support: $105 BRL

·      Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting total monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $9,000 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.


Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. 


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:


·      High-performance bonus: When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a “CLS Certified Investigator’s Assistant” (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.


Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office

Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.


Minimum/Required and Preferred Qualifications

·      Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

·      A minimum of 1 year of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 1-year requirement).

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, is preferred. 

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred.


Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST:

·      At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English is required . Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English.

·      A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is required.

·      Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues is preferred.

·      A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A Master's Degree is preferred.

·      Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year, is preferred .

You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Hiring: Cloud Engineer (GCP / AWS / Python / AVID MAM)

Location: Remote / Hybrid (based on region)

Experience Level: Mid–Senior


About the Role


We are looking for a skilled Cloud Engineer with strong experience across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Python development, and workflow migration. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on expertise with AVID Media Asset Management (MAM) systems and the ability to support modern CI/CD deployment practices.


This role involves cloud-based workflow modernization, application and media workflow migration, automation scripting, and integration across cloud environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, implement, and support solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and AWS.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and integrations using Python.
  • Lead or support workflow migration initiatives from legacy systems to cloud-native architectures.
  • Work with AVID MAM systems for media workflow integration, configuration, and automation support.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support continuous deployment and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, media operations, DevOps) to design efficient and scalable solutions.
  • Troubleshoot cloud-based applications, media workflows, and infrastructure issues.


Required Skills & Experience


  • Strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with AWS services, cloud deployment models, and cross-cloud integration.
  • Proficiency in Python for automation, scripting, data processing, or workflow integration.
  • Proven experience in workflow migration (media workflows preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • AVID MAM (Avid Media Asset Management) experience is mandatory.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and document cloud and media workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a distributed team.


Nice to Have


  • Experience with media workflows, broadcast systems, or video delivery platforms.
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with storage, CDN, streaming, or metadata management in cloud environments.

title: Consultora de moda
description:
Sobre a Koisa Linda


Fundada em 1994, a Koisa Linda é uma das maiores referências em moda festa no estado do Rio de Janeiro. Há mais de 30 anos, vestimos noivas, debutantes, madrinhas, convidados e o público masculino, sempre com foco em experiência, organização e excelência no atendimento .


Estamos iniciando um novo ciclo de profissionalização e expansão da área comercial e buscamos Consultoras de Moda que queiram crescer junto com a empresa, dentro de um Plano de Carreira estruturado .



O que faz uma Consultora de Moda na Koisa Linda


Esta não é uma vaga genérica de vendas.

Você será responsável por conduzir o cliente em toda a jornada , desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento do contrato, seguindo processos claros.


No dia a dia, você vai:


  • Receber e acolher clientes (noivas, debutantes, madrinhas, convidados e público masculino) de forma elegante e profissional.
  • Fazer escuta ativa para entender evento, sonho, estilo, orçamento e necessidades.
  • Apresentar opções de looks (vestidos, ternos e combinações) de forma consultiva , explicando cortes, tecidos e caimento.
  • Organizar e acompanhar as provas : separar peças, montar cabides, apoiar a cliente no provador e garantir fluidez no atendimento.
  • Conduzir o fechamento da venda : apresentar valores, condições, explicar o contrato e alinhar datas.
  • Registrar clientes, atendimentos e contratos no sistema , mantendo as informações atualizadas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com prova, costura e despacho, garantindo que o combinado com o cliente seja cumprido.
  • Cuidar da organização da loja, vitrines e araras, preservando o padrão visual da marca.



Responsabilidades


  • Atender com excelência e acompanhamento personalizado.
  • Seguir o manual de vendas , processos internos e padrões da marca.
  • Organizar provas, pedidos, ajustes e devoluções dentro dos prazos.
  • Cumprir metas individuais e contribuir para a meta da unidade .
  • Garantir experiência premium em todas as etapas do atendimento.
  • Registrar informações e acompanhar contratos no sistema.



Requisitos


  • Comunicação clara, empatia e elegância.
  • Organização, disciplina e responsabilidade.
  • Perfil comercial e facilidade em trabalhar com metas.
  • Desejável experiência em moda festa, consultoria de imagem ou boutiques de moda.
  • Disponibilidade para rotina de loja (terça a sábado) e eventuais domingos de campanha.



O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo compatível com o mercado.
  • Comissão vinculada à meta individual.
  • Bônus da unidade (quando aplicável).
  • Treinamento inicial estruturado e treinamento contínuo em vendas e produtos.
  • Plano de Carreira com trilha clara :

    • Consultora Júnior
    • Consultora Pleno
    • Consultora Sênior
    • Supervisor
    • Gerente
    • Ambiente de trabalho organizado, com cultura em desenvolvimento e forte potencial de crescimento para quem entrega resultado e postura profissional.



    Locais de trabalho


    Estamos contratando para as unidades:


    • São Francisco – Niterói (RJ)
    • Barra da Tijuca – Downtown (RJ) – nova unidade


    A unidade de atuação será alinhada durante o processo seletivo, conforme necessidade da empresa e perfil da candidata.



    Tipo de vaga


    • Regime: Tempo integral
    • Modalidade: Presencial
    • Setor: Comércio varejista de artigos do vestuário e acessórios

title: Research Assistant
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth. Here is what we offer:
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

The Research Assistant will contribute to interdisciplinary projects within the Department of Internal Medicine at the Howard University College of Medicine, focusing on Artificial Intelligence (AI) , Machine Learning (ML) , Computational Medicine , and Data Analytics . This position supports ongoing research aimed at developing predictive, diagnostic, and intervention models that advance healthcare delivery, improve patient outcomes, and address complex challenges in precision and population health.

The Research Assistant will work closely with the Principal Investigator and research collaborators to perform data-driven analysis, computational modeling, and literature reviews. This role provides valuable hands-on experience for students interested in research at the intersection of AI and medicine.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assist with data collection, curation, preprocessing, and integration from diverse biomedical and clinical sources.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis , data visualization, and feature engineering.
  • Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models .
  • Review scientific literature and summarize findings to support ongoing research projects.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, manuscripts, and progress reports .
  • Collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams across research and clinical domains.
  • Maintain accurate records of research workflows, results, and code repositories.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Current enrollment in a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field .
  • Must be at least a third-year undergraduate student (Junior or Senior status) or higher.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Python and related libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch .
  • Familiarity with data analysis and visualization using tools such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly.
  • Foundational understanding of AI, machine learning, and data science concepts .
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and written communication skills .
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a research environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with biomedical, clinical, or public health datasets .
  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure).
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git/GitHub).
  • Prior research or academic publication experience .

title: Financial Aid Counselor
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth. Here is what we offer:
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

BASIC FUNCTION:

The Financial Aid Counselor provides excellent customer service and guidance to financial aid applicants and their families throughout the financial aid application process; determines eligibility within the parameters of institutional, state and federal requirements.

SUPERVISORY ACCOUNTABILITY:

May be responsible for the supervision of student employees in the financial aid office.

NATURE AND SCOPE:

Internal contacts include students, faculty and staff. External contacts include families, prospective students, student advocates, and representatives of government agencies, lending institutions, guarantee agencies, community organizations, legislative representatives, and the general public.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Exercises independent judgment in the management of operational details of the financial aid process including but not limited to:
  • Provide advising throughout the financial aid process to prospective, new and current students and their families.
  • Reviews incoming financial aid application and any supporting documentation needed to determine the accuracy of the financial and household information reported on the FAFSA. This requires knowledge of not only federal financial aid regulations but IRS tax laws and how they relate to federal financial aid.
  • Complete assigned duties with a high degree of accuracy to ensure compliance while experiencing multiple interruptions.
  • Exercise great attention to detail when completing assignments as error in judgment or calculations could result in unintended consequences for the student and/or the institution such as under or over funding of a student, loss of student eligibility, audit findings, fines, damage to school’s reputation or loss of institutional eligibility.
  • Will have the authority to recalculate and makes changes to financial aid awards when student’s eligibility changes.
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state and institutional policies as it relates to the awarding and disbursements of federal, state and institutional aid.
  • Assists with the oversight of the administration of both the federal and private loans. This includes the certification of private education loans, resolving issues between the university’s system and the Dept. of Educations. Participation in state, regional and national professional development activities to ensure a complete understanding of federal and state regulations and remain current on changes to the federal and state aid programs.
  • Must utilize conflict resolution skill set to pacify disgruntled students and parents, helping them to understand the situation and identify potential solutions to issues.
  • Maintain student confidentiality in accordance with FERPA regulations.
  • Ensures that students are receiving Exit Counseling information upon withdrawal, graduation or dropping below half time.
  • Monitors TEACH grant eligibility; checks GPA after each semester, ensure required documents are complete, send TEACH Exit information, etc.
  • On an occasional basis, travel to an off-campus meeting site to attend institutional workshops;
  • Maintain work area in a neat and orderly fashion
  • Assist the management and other office staff in special project assignments;
  • Participates in committees under the direction of the Manager of Financial Aid counselors to review Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) appeals, Professional Judgment requests, and Howard University Scholarship appeals, as needed.
  • May be required to work evenings and weekends
  • Other duties as assigned by the financial aid director/associate director and/or Manager of Financial Aid Counselors.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Must have a thorough knowledge of available types of financial aid, scholarships and general student eligibility criteria.
  • Familiar with financial documents and a high competency of computer skills
  • Proficiency in technology and the systems used to determine student’s eligibility and originate a financial aid award. (These may include but not limited to: Banner, NSLDS, COD, CPS, ELM, MS, School Servicing Center, Campus Logic, Word, Excel, etc.)
  • Ability to interpret complex financial aid regulations and apply appropriately in different situations
  • Understanding personal income tax laws as they relate to federal financial aid
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the ability to use sound judgment for decision-making

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor’s Degree and at least two years of experience in financial aid (or a related area) or the equivalent combination of education and work experience combined.

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $65,000 - $70,000

  • Assists in the preparation of training manuals and training documentation for on-going contracts training, ensuring that manuals are updated appropriately with the newest version of procedures.

  • Assists with training faculty, staff, and students on legal issues in grants and contracts administration.

  • Promotes adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.

  • Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy training.

  • Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.

  • Actively participates in Health Sciences Compliance Program activities. Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures. Maintains confidentiality of patients, families, faculty, students, and staff.

  • Performs other job related duties within the assigned timeframes assigned by Director.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Sensitive to the interrelationship of both people and functions within the department. Ability to apply strict confidentiality regarding budget issues.

  • Strong team building and interpersonal skills Strong project and relationship management skills

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious working relations with staff, University officials and the general public

  • Good communication skills Customer service orientation

  • Must be able to read and interpret the underlying purpose of contractual agreements, including the concepts of offer and acceptance and bargained-for transaction.

  • Knowledge of the healthcare industry and of University purchasing practices, procedures and techniques is also desirable.

  • Must be comfortable communicating instructions and process information to customers of all levels within the organization, including executive leaders.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of Government Contracting and related laws, regulations and guidelines such as FARS.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the terminology related to the sponsored research agreements.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of basic contracting phases such as pre-award award and post-award.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of principles, practices and methodologies of accounting including grant administration and budget policies and procedures

  • Knowledge of computer skills: spreadsheet, database, word processing, and presentation software as well as other standard office equipment. Ability to use technology – contract management software and a standard suite of office software applications

  • Ability to organize information, generate reports and maintain data regarding contracts and contract process requests in a database.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of basic contracting phases such as pre-award award and post-award.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of principles, practices and methodologies of accounting including grant administration and budget policies and procedures

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field of study

  • 5 to 8 years experience in an academic, healthcare environment or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and training.

  • Experienced with the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR/DFAR) a plus

  • Possession of a Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), a Certified Research Administrator, or Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) certification is preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $76,500 - $85,000

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Chief Operating Officer (COO) Howard University Faculty Practice Plan
Position Summary

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) of the Howard University Faculty Practice Plan (FPP) serves as the senior operational leader responsible for the strategic, financial, and administrative oversight of the physician enterprise. The COO ensures that all ambulatory and faculty practice operations function efficiently and are aligned with the mission of Howard University and its academic health enterprise.

The COO partners closely with the CEO/Executive Director of the FPP, clinical department chairs, practice administrators, hospital leadership, and the College of Medicine to drive performance, expand access, strengthen the patient experience, and support the clinical, educational, and research missions.

Key Responsibilities Operational Leadership of the Physician Enterprise
  • Provide executive oversight of all ambulatory clinics, faculty practices, and related clinical operations.
  • Lead day-to-day operational performance including patient flow, scheduling, clinic throughput, call center performance, and care coordination.
  • Ensure that clinical operations meet standards of safety, quality, service excellence, and regulatory compliance.
  • Implement consistent operational policies, workflows, and performance standards across departments and practice sites.

Strategic Planning & Growth

  • Develop and execute strategies to support practice expansion, new clinical programs, and service line growth.
  • Assess market and demographic trends to inform future planning and provider network development.
  • Partner with University and hospital leadership to align practice operations with broader academic and clinical priorities.
  • Support recruitment planning, provider onboarding, and optimization of clinical FTE utilization.

Provider Access, Productivity & Performance Optimization

  • Lead initiatives to improve provider productivity, panel management, template design, and clinical capacity utilization.
  • Partner with department chairs and practice leaders to set and monitor operational KPIs (e.g., access metrics, cycle time, provider productivity, patient satisfaction).
  • Support performance review processes, compensation model implementation, and incentive alignment.

Financial & Revenue Cycle Management

  • Collaborate with the CFO to manage operating budgets, financial forecasts, and profitability of service lines.
  • Provide operational leadership for revenue cycle functions (e.g., registration, scheduling, charge capture workflows, documentation optimization, denial reduction).
  • Work with central revenue cycle leaders to ensure clean claims, timely billing, and improved collections.
  • Evaluate and optimize payer mix, managed care leverage, and ambulatory financial performance.

Systems, Technology & Data Integration

  • Oversee optimization of the electronic health record (EHR) and other clinical information systems to support efficient workflows.
  • Ensure accurate, real-time dashboards and data analytics to drive decision-making.
  • Champion the use of technology, automation, and digital health solutions to improve access and patient engagement.

Regulatory, Compliance & Quality Oversight

  • Ensure operational compliance with CMS, Joint Commission, ambulatory accreditation standards, HIPAA, OSHA, and related federal and local regulations.
  • Partner with quality leaders to strengthen ambulatory quality and patient safety programs.
  • Lead operational readiness for audits, surveys, and accreditation activities.

Leadership, Culture & People Management

  • Build and develop high-performing administrative and operational teams.
  • Promote a culture of equity, accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and leadership development to practice managers and administrative staff.
  • Strengthen physician–administrative partnerships across departments.

Collaboration with Academic & Hospital Partners

  • Work closely with the College of Medicine to align clinical operations with teaching and training needs.
  • Coordinate with Howard University Hospital leadership to ensure smooth inpatient–outpatient continuum of care.
  • Assist in integrating residents and students into clinic operations in compliance with accreditation requirements.
Qualifications Education
  • Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Public Health, or a related field required.
  • Additional certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or ambulatory operations preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience in an academic medical center, faculty practice plan, or large multispecialty physician group.
  • Strong experience in ambulatory operations, physician enterprise management, and performance improvement.
  • Demonstrated success improving access, financial performance, and operational efficiency across multiple clinical departments.
  • Experience in a mission-driven, culturally diverse, urban healthcare environment preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.
  • Deep understanding of physician practice economics and healthcare reimbursement.
  • Demonstrated change management and project management capability.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and physician-relations skills.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Job Title: Quality Assurance Specialist 

Company: Vytelle 

Reporting to: IO Program Manager 

Direct Reports: None 

Location: Brazil 

Salary Range: Contractor 

Status: 1.0 FTE 


ABOUT VYTELLE 

We are a global precision livestock company reshaping how cattle producers worldwide unlock animal performance. Our portfolio includes world class Bovine phenotypic and genotypic data capture system via Vytelle SENSE and Vytelle INSIGHT which enables producers to accurately select desired traits to continually produce elite progeny, coupled with Vytelle ADVANCE In Vitro Fertilization Service, which enhances the speed at which genetic improvement can be made. 


ROLE OVERVIEW 

We are seeking a seasoned Quality Assurance Manager with a robust background in technology and software development. This role is designed for a dynamic professional who excels in leading quality assurance and control initiatives, ensuring the highest standards of quality in our cloud-based architecture solutions. With a pivotal role in our organization, the Quality Assurance Manager will be instrumental in driving our product excellence and customer satisfaction to new heights. 


ROLE OVERVIEW 

The Quality Assurance Specialist – SENSE Platform is a technically skilled professional with a software development background who is passionate about building quality into every layer of our product. This role is ideal for a developer who wants to broaden into quality engineering — combining hands-on coding, test automation, and problem-solving across SENSE’s three major components: 

  • Telemetry App: real-time, per-second data capture at customer sites. 
  • Data Processing Pipeline: cloud services that transform raw telemetry into daily phenotype values. 
  • Web UI Applications: dashboards, analytics, & animal trial management tools. 

You will play a pivotal role in designing, automating, and executing tests that ensure data integrity, performance, and reliability across this full ecosystem — from device to dashboard. 


FIRST 90 DAYS 

  • Learn SENSE’s architecture, data flows, and operational objectives. 
  • Review QA documentation, test scripts, and known defect logs to understand baseline coverage. 
  • Build familiarity with the existing development and CI/CD environments (AWS, GitHub Actions, Playwright). 
  • Begin authoring automated tests for one end-to-end SENSE workflow (Telemetry → Cloud → UI). 
  • Partner with developers and the Product Assurance Manager to define acceptance criteria and test coverage for upcoming releases. 
  • Identify quick-win improvements for testing efficiency and reporting visibility. 


RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated and manual tests for SENSE’s data-capture, processing, and visualization layers. 
  • Conduct white-box tests (code-level, API, and service integration) and black-box tests (UI, end-user workflow, regression). 
  • Collaborate with developers to integrate testing directly into CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Build and maintain test harnesses for RESTful APIs, data streams, and web services. 
  • Write and review test scripts in Python, JavaScript, or C# to validate logic and data transformations. 
  • Troubleshoot telemetry-to-cloud data discrepancies, working with developers to isolate root causes. 
  • Contribute to the design of performance and reliability tests for high-frequency sensor data. 
  • Participate in UAT and release readiness reviews, ensuring alignment with product requirements and field conditions. 
  • Document test results, create bug reports, and verify fixes. 
  • Continuously learn new QA tools, frameworks, and automation approaches.


SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE 

Education and Background: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent technical field. 
  • 3–6 years of software development or test-automation experience. 
  • Strong interest in transitioning toward or expanding within Quality Assurance. 
  • Experience working with distributed or IoT-style systems is an asset. 

Technical Skills: 

  • Solid programming knowledge in Python, C#/.NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
  • Experience with automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, PyTest, Postman/Newman) 
  •  Familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and message-based architectures. 
  • Understanding of relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) data stores. 
  • Exposure to AWS environments (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS) is a plus. 
  • Comfortable working in Linux and Windows environments. 
  • Knowledge of Git, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD tools. 
  • Preferred: experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and telemetry data pipelines. 

Soft Skills: 

  • Analytical and curious mindset — enjoys tracing a defect through multiple code layers. 
  • Strong communication skills across remote, multi-disciplinary teams. 
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, iterative environment. 
  • Collaborative attitude and willingness to learn new domains (ag-tech, IoT, data science). 
  • Because this role supports global teams and requires regular communication with colleagues and customers in English-speaking regions, proficiency in English (verbal and written) is required. Candidates must be able to read, write, and speak English fluently to perform the essential functions of the position.


SUCCESS METRICS 

  • Increased automation coverage across all SENSE components. 
  • Faster regression cycles and fewer escaped defects in production. 
  • Reduced test execution time through CI/CD integration. 
  • Verified data accuracy between telemetry capture and phenotype calculation.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Node + React
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior - Node + React


*Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


*Nosso cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente que atua no segmento de fabricação e comercialização de eletrodomésticos e eletroportáteis.


*O que buscamos?

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior com sólida experiência em Node.js, React, SQL, Crons, Docker, Argo CD, Sequelize e TypeORM. O profissional será responsável por um novo projeto.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Node.js, utilizando Sequelize e TypeORM para interação com bancos de dados relacionais.

• Criar e otimizar APIs RESTful e serviços para comunicação entre sistemas.

• Implementar e manter aplicações frontend utilizando React.js e TailwindCSS.

• Criar e gerenciar tarefas agendadas (crons) para automação de processos críticos.

• Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e orquestração com Argo CD.

• Desenvolver consultas otimizadas em SQL Server, PostgreSQL ou MySQL.

• Atuar na integração e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para garantir entregas contínuas e seguras.

• Diagnosticar e corrigir problemas de performance e segurança no backend e frontend.

• Trabalhar com metodologias ágeis, garantindo boas práticas de Clean Code e Design Patterns.


*O que você precisa ter

• Experiência avançada com Node.js (Express, NestJS).

• Experiência com React.js e boas práticas de frontend.

• Conhecimento sólido em bancos SQL e ORM (Sequelize e TypeORM).

• Experiência com criação e gerenciamento de Jobs/crons para automação.

• Conhecimento avançado em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de containers.

• Experiência com orquestração de deploys usando Argo CD.

• Prática com CI/CD e deploys automatizados.

• Boa experiência com integração de APIs e segurança (JWT, OAuth, OpenID).

• Sólidos conhecimentos em estruturas de dados, algoritmos e padrões de arquitetura.


*Diferenciais:

• Experiência com NestJS e arquitetura Clean Code.

• Conhecimento em Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código.

• Experiência com mensageria (Redis).

• Conhecimento em React Native.


Observações:

• Oportunidade para 6 meses iniciais e grande possibilidade de prorrogação.


*Onde você vai trabalhar?

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Híbrido em Curitiba – PR, no Bacacheri. São 3 dias presenciais e 2 remotos. O dia que todos vão presencial é na quarta e os outros 2 dias de presencial o profissional pode escolher. Importante ressaltar que o primeiro mês é 100% presencial para imersão no ambiente, treinamentos e alinhamentos. O híbrido se aplica a partir do mês subsequente.

This position is responsible for ensuring that high quality, innovative, and financially sustainable operations are in place and effectively managed to support HU FPP. The CEO of HU FPP will help to ensure that HU FPP is well-positioned in a rapidly evolving and competitive environment through optimized and systematic physician practice management. Additionally, in conjunction with the management team, this position will lead efforts to collaborate with community healthcare providers to enhance patient access in the communities served by HU FPP.

Create and maintain a culture of accountability and serve as a resource for attaining performance metrics in all areas of the HU FPP

Effective communication of the mission, vision, values, and strategic vision of HU FPP to internal and external stakeholders

Evaluate strategic partnership opportunities with community-based organizations, payors, and other community stakeholders

Identify new opportunities in population health and with alternative payment models

Ability to work collaboratively with Chairs, Leadership and departmental Administrators, Physicians and Staff from diverse background and perspectives, across clinical and academic missions of an academic medical center to ensure efficient, effective clinic operations, while creating an environment conducive to engagement and satisfaction among physicians, other practitioners, and clinical staff

Knowledge:

* Knowledge of advanced primary care practice principles and Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) principles

* Ability to communicate with physicians, academic department leaders and senior administrators to maintain coordination with other organizational programs
